event.name: Surgical Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation Simulation
event.descriptionText:
Goal: Comprehensive surgical AF management: full biatrial Cox-Maze 4 lesion sets, hybrid Convergent procedure, LAA exclusion using the AtriClip system, cryoablation probe for thoracotomy pain management.

·        Box lesion and full Cox-Maze IV lesion set with bipolar clamp and cryo probe

·        Convergent hybrid approach: epicardial/endocardial coordination

·        AtriClip model and sizing overview, deployment technique, and confirmation of complete LAA exclusion

·        Energy source selection, upcoming technology, injury avoidance

·        Review of cryotheraphy evidence and technique for intercostal nerve blocks
